questions.q_en: The sum of the measures of 7 interior angles of an 8 -sided polygon is 1000°. What is the measure of the 8th exterior angle of the polygon?
questions.q_hi: 8 भुजाओं वाले एक बहुभुज के 7 आंतरिक कोणों के मापों का योग 1000° है। इस बहुभुज के 8वें बाह्य कोण का माप क्या है?
options_en: 1080
1180
1000
800
options_hi: 1080
1180
1000
800
questions.solution_en:
Each exterior angle =(360°)/n (n ; number of side)

= (360°)/8=45°

Each interior angle = 180°-45° = 135°

(∵ Exterior + interior angle = 180°, in a polygon)

Sum of all interior angle = 135°×8=1080°

given = Sum of 7 interior angle = 1000°

8th interior angle = (1080°-1000°)

= 80°

⇒So, 8th exterior angle = 180°-80°=100°
questions.solution_hi:
प्रत्येक बाहरी कोण = (360°)/n (n = भुजाओं की संख्या)

= (360°)/8 = 45°

प्रत्येक आंतरिक कोण = 180° - 45° = 135°

(∵ किसी बहुभुज में बाहरी + आंतरिक कोण = 180°)

सभी आंतरिक कोणों का योग = 135° × 8 = 1080°

दिया गया है = 7 आंतरिक कोणों का योग = 1000°

8वाँ आंतरिक कोण = (1080° - 1000°)

= 80°

⇒ इसलिए 8वाँ बाहरी कोण = 180° - 80° = 100°

questions.q_en: In ABC, AM BC and AN is the bisector of A. What is the measure of MAN, if B = 55°and C = 35°?
questions.q_hi: ABC में, AMBC है और AN, A का समद्विभाजक है। MAN का माप क्या है, यदि B = 55° और C = 35° है?
options_en: 10°
12°
15°
5°
options_hi: 10°
12°
15°
5°
questions.solution_en:
Given that AM ⊥ BC
AN is angle bisector
∠B = 55 ̊, ∠C = 35 ̊
Now: ∠A =180 - [55 + 35] = 90 ̊
∴∠BAN = = 45 ̊ [angle bisector]
In △AMB,
∠BAM = 90 55 ̊= 35 ̊
∴∠MAN = ∠BAN - ∠BAM = 45 - 35 ̊
∠MAN =10 ̊
2nd method:
Remember :
∠MAN = [∠B - ∠C]
∴∠MAN = [55 - 35] = =10 ̊
questions.solution_hi:
दिया गया है कि AM ⊥ BC
AN कोण समद्विभाजक है
∠B = 55 ̊, ∠C = 35 ̊
अब: ∠A =180 - [55 + 35] = 90 ̊
∴∠BAN = = 45 ̊ [कोण समद्विभाजक]
△AMB में,
∠BAM = 90 – 55 ̊= 35 ̊
∴∠MAN = ∠BAN - ∠BAM = 45 - 35 ̊
∠MAN =10 ̊
दूसरी विधि:
याद रखें:
∠MAN = [∠B - ∠C]
∴∠MAN = [55 - 35] = =10 ̊

questions.q_en: In ABC, M is the midpoint of the side AB. N is a point in the interior of ABC such that CN is the bisector of C and CN NB. What is the length [in cm] of MN, if BC = 10 cm and AC = 15 cm?
questions.q_hi: ABC में, M भुजा AB का मध्यबिंदु है। N, ABC के आंतरिक भाग में एक बिंदु है जिससे CN, C का समद्विभाजक है और CN NB है। MN की लंबाई [सेमी में] क्या है, यदि BC = 10 सेमी और AC = 15 सेमी है?
options_en:
2.5

questions.solution_en:
CN is angle bisector, So, CN NB, So, CN ND also, 

And, line CN is common in both the triangles BNC and DNC

So, △BNC ≅ △DNC

So, BN = ND 

Also, CB = CD = 10 cm

Now, in △ABD, M is the mid point of AB and N is the mid point of BD,

So, by Mid point theorem,

MN is half the length of AD
AD = AC - CD = 15 - 10 = 5 cm

MN =  =  = 2.5cm

(3,4)
(3,8)

Euler’s line passes through: Orthocenter (H), Centroid (а), Circumcenter (0) Centroid divides the line joining Orthocenter and Circumcenter in 2:1.

(3,0) (3,4) (3,8)
